P01.drivers: Slim average proportions, normal shoulder-to-hip ratio, ordinary S-curve spine and glute in profile, normal limb lengths

P02.drivers: Average build with slight soft belly and rounded glutes; human proportions throughout

P03.drivers: Slender to average build, slight belly in profile, normal proportions

P04.drivers: Rectangular box-like trunk: very flat, nearly vertical front and back planes in profile, almost no waist, trunk width carried straight down to a hard ledge at the hip/thigh junction; limbs comparatively thin and straight relative to the massive trunk block; trunk volume is not distributed like human fat (no soft belly sag), it reads as a different section shape
limb_cues: short-looking thighs relative to trunk mass

P05.drivers: Very pinched narrow waist under a broad, rounded upper back hump and deep chest; long arms with hands reaching low and elbows/forearms angled out; profile shows a strong rearward bulge of the upper back, a forward-shifted pelvis and bulging knee/calf contour; overall segment relations not human
axial_cues: large convex upper-back mass in profile
deep chest vs very narrow waist

P06.drivers: Broad-shouldered fit male proportions with normal taper, normal profile

P07.drivers: Fit average male proportions, normal glute and back curve

P08.drivers: Barrel-shaped, very deep trunk with rounded front and back in profile and little waist, ending in a ledge at the hip/thigh junction; thin arms and legs relative to trunk; same trunk architecture as P04 with slightly more rounded belly. Could be read as an obese human, but the box/barrel section and limb-trunk disproportion look structural rather than fat distribution

P10.drivers: Same body plan as P05: broad rounded upper back/shoulder mass with a very narrow pinched waist and narrow pelvis, long arms with outward-angled forearms and low-reaching hands, profile with large upper-back convexity and prominent knee bulge

P11.drivers: Fit male proportions, normal taper and profile

groups.label: box/barrel-trunk race: flat or barrel deep trunk, no waist, hip ledge, thin limbs
hump-backed wasp-waist race: big upper-back mass, pinched waist, long out-flared arms

distinguishing_features: P04/P08 have a wide, deep rectangular or barrel trunk with no waist, flat or rounded back planes and a step at the pelvis-thigh junction, carried on comparatively thin straight limbs. P05/P10 have the opposite trunk organization: mass sits in a rounded upper back and chest above a very narrow waist and pelvis, with long arms whose forearms flare outward and prominent knee contours in profile. The split between the two ordinary human groups (P01-P03 vs P06-P12) is soft and mostly reflects build. P08 is the case most likely to be misread as an obese human. P05 has a slightly hunched upper-back silhouette, but neither of those two bodies reads as crouched.
